title: Cashback Payout Concentration by Program
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), cashback events (`cashback:event`), price tracker alerts (`pricetrack:alert`), and tip logs (`tiplog:shift`).
app: Micro-finance telemetry for latte-factor spending, cashback apps, price tracking, and tip logging sent to Splunk HEC via finance exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cashback:event
| search event_type="payout"
| stats sum(payout_amount) as payout_amount count as payouts by program_name
| sort 0 - payout_amount
description: Ranks programss by cashback payout concentration.
value: Payout concentration shows which program is actually worth your attention and which ones are just noise.
implementation: Send cashback payout concentration events to `index=personal` and keep `program_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of cashback payout concentration by programs.
grandmaExplanation: It blends which programss stand out most for cashback payout concentration.
